points.description: Gives two valid, distinct lists, each reached by valid reasoning (or at least not contradicted by invalid steps), with the correct answers being (1, 7, 103, 105) and (3, 5, 101, 107). Both lists must be given; each must produce exactly the pairwise sums 8, 104, 106, 110, 112, 208. Any error in a step or a wrong or unverified list earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark (1) only if two correct distinct lists, (1,7,103,105) and (3,5,101,107), are given and every step is valid. Any wrong step, wrong list, or only one list earns 0. No part marks.
rubric.answer_key:
Smallest sum is a1+a2=8, next a1+a3=104. Largest is a3+a4=208, next a2+a4=112. The remaining sums 106 and 110 are a1+a4 and a2+a3 in some order.
Case 1: a1+a4=106, a2+a3=110. From a1+a2=8 and a1+a3=104, a3-a2=96. With a2+a3=110, a3=103 and a2=7. Then a1=1 and a4=105. Check: 8, 104, 106, 110, 112, 208 ✓. List (1,7,103,105).
Case 2: a1+a4=110, a2+a3=106. Then a3-a2=96, so a3=101 and a2=5. Then a1=3 and a4=107. Check: 8, 104, 110, 106, 112, 208 ✓. List (3,5,101,107).
Final answer: (1,7,103,105) and (3,5,101,107).
